name: Process Definition
description: An admin-authored process: what it runs against, its stages, its steps, who may run it and how it scores. Published versions are immutable — editing forks version+1 — so a run from March replays March's process exactly.

fields.label: Process Code
fields.description: Stable identifier including the version suffix, e.g. BATTERY_QC-v1.

fields.label: Family
fields.description: Groups every version of the same process. Versions share a family; the newest Published one in a family is what operators get.

fields.label: Status
fields.description: Set via the Publish and Retire actions, not by editing.

fields.label: Subject
fields.description: What this process runs against. This one field is what lets the same engine serve battery QC, vehicle PDI and a standalone audit.

fields.label: Subject DocType
fields.description: Leave blank for a standalone process that attaches to nothing.

fields.label: Subject Label
fields.description: What the operator calls it — 'Battery Pack', 'Bus'.

fields.label: Identifier Mode
fields.options:
Scan QR
Manual Entry
Auto Generate
Pick From List
From Context

fields.label: Identifier Validation Pattern
fields.description: Optional regex the typed or scanned identifier must match. Blank accepts anything.

fields.label: Identifier Keypad
fields.description: Numbers Only shows the phone's number pad and refuses letters. Use it when the label is a plain serial number.

fields.label: Customer
fields.description: Blank = available to every customer. Set it to scope this process to one customer's sites.

fields.label: Stage Label
fields.description: The word operators see for a stage — 'Module', 'Phase', 'Section'. The schema says Stage; your team sees this.

fields.label: Who May Run This
fields.description: Empty means any user holding Process Operator.

fields.label: Who May Edit This
fields.description: Scopes authoring to a team, e.g. Battery QA Admin edits the battery process but not Vehicle PDI. Empty means any Process Author.

fields.label: Conditional Visibility
fields.description: Optional. A step with no clause here is always shown. Clauses are matched to their step by code and fold left to right — no operator precedence, so they read exactly as listed.

fields.label: Scoring Mode
fields.description: Weighted uses each step's weight; Simple counts every scoreable step equally.

fields.label: Critical Fails Allowed
fields.description: A run above the threshold still fails if it exceeds this. Zero means any critical fail fails the run.

fields.label: Skipped Steps Count As
fields.description: Excluded keeps a skipped step out of both numerator and denominator.

fields.label: Minimum App Capability
fields.description: Computed on publish from the step types used. An older app that reports a lower capability renders unknown steps read-only instead of crashing.

fields.label: Default Report Brand
fields.description: Falls back to the engine-wide default. The brand is always overridable when a report is generated.
